concern_summary: The concern focuses on managing the status of thread reports by retrieving actions and transactions that are currently marked as on hold, allowing for the monitoring and handling of report-related activities.
Processing and management of transaction thread reports, including updates to merchant information and handling of financial details linked to reports.
A concern focused on generating and managing the full thread report, determining the rendering of transaction thread violations, and preparing related data for display.
Retrieval and management of report actions associated with transaction threads for display and interaction, ensuring proper ordering and visibility.

This concern focuses on validating the structure of the thread report data, ensuring that there is one valid participant in the report who is not the current user and confirming the participant's account status.
This concern encompasses the overall management and collection of thread reports, including the retrieval, display, and updating of reports in relation to workspace member status.
Identification and processing of reports associated with transaction threads, including checking for violations and managing optimistic updates for duplicate transactions.
Management of user interactions and navigation within thread-related reports, enabling seamless access to various actions and reports associated with a specific thread.

This concern focuses on determining the ownership of thread reports by comparing the report's owner information with the current user's account ID, ensuring that users can access only the reports they own.
The functionality related to notifying users when a specific user is leaving a room, which may be part of a larger context of user interactions and status updates in thread reports.
